verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs say users can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks and more to get answers, summaries and insights, and files can also feed Deep Research. Hands-on reports back the accuracy claim for PDFs: a fintech team swapped its OCR vendor for Gemini at about 96% of the vendor's accuracy, and NotebookLM (powered by Gemini) is praised for understanding large source corpuses. One user did report wildly inaccurate bounding boxes when locating elements in documents. Missing for 10: PDFs are not named explicitly in the upload docs, there is no hands-on evidence of spreadsheet analysis, and fine-grained extraction such as bounding boxes is unreliable.
